tagline: Leading Nordic energy company powering sustainable future
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross margin strongly improved by 200 bps to reach 32%, reflecting optimization of the energy mix and reduced production costs despite price volatility. Key indicator of profitability in the Nordic energy sector.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total sales generated by the company during the year.
kpis.description: Growth driven by energy prices and stable production. Strength of the Nordic energy portfolio amid increased demand.
kpis.signal: Revenue significantly up despite energy volatility.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Improved cost efficiency and optimized energy mix. Sustained improvement in operating profitability driven by better utilization of existing assets.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on new equipment or infrastructure.
kpis.description: Targeted investments in renewables and maintenance. Strategic commitment to the energy transition of the Nordic portfolio.
kpis.signal: Capex up to modernize the energy fleet.

kpis.name: Net Debt
kpis.explanation: Total financial debt minus available cash.
kpis.description: Solid financing structure despite moderate increase in leverage. Prudent capital management amid higher investment levels.

kpis.name: Return on Capital Employed
kpis.description: ROCE improving due to better asset utilization. Enhanced efficiency of capital employed in energy operations.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of sales, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Reduced production costs and sustained selling prices. Performance supported by better cost control and favorable energy pricing.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 0.74 EUR in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 1.256 Bn EUR in the latest year.

risks.title: Human rights risks in the supply chain
risks.score_rationale: Recurrently mentioned in the supply chain section with moderate language ('potential risk', 'may be linked to'). Stable trend with corrective actions underway. Material category identified in the double materiality assessment.

risks.title: Impact of wind operations on indigenous peoples
risks.score_rationale: Specific risk identified as a material negative impact in the double materiality assessment, related to a joint venture in Sweden and Norway. Cautious language ('potential impacts', 'does not have control'). Stable trend, structural risk linked to decarbonization strategy.

risks.title: Dependence on high-risk component suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly identified for 14 metals and minerals assessed in 2024, with recognition that 'metals and minerals generally involve significant sustainability risks'. Trend increasing due to growth in renewable energy. Category weight significant for an energy transition company.

risks.title: Safety of subcontracted workers at operational sites
risks.score_rationale: Identified as a material negative impact (IRO S2.3) with strong language ('key priority'). Mentioned multiple times in the document with dedicated programs (Safety and Security Leadership Programme). Stable trend with active mitigation measures.

risks.title: Increasing regulatory compliance in due diligence
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk in multiple references to regulatory frameworks (UN Guiding Principles, OECD Guidelines, ILO). Supplier data management system not yet finalized (target 2026), indicating potential compliance lag. Trend increasing with tightening of European ESG regulations.

risks.title: Social risks related to the development of new energy sites
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified as a medium-term negative impact related to development sites. Moderate language with preventive actions in place (screening tool). Trend increasing due to acceleration of renewable energy deployment in Fortum's strategy.

risks.title: Insufficient visibility on vulnerable workers in subcontracting
risks.score_rationale: Fortum explicitly acknowledges having 'limited visibility to vulnerable groups, such as migrant workers in the supply chain'. No tracking system for value chain worker reporting channels. Stable trend with corrective actions planned but not yet deployed.

ai_positioning.summary: Fortum does not mention any strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in the provided documents. The company does not position AI as a technological or operational lever.
evidence: No mention of AI in the Business, MD&A or Risks sections.
No references to automation, predictive analytics or AI-driven optimization projects.
Complete absence of vocabulary related to AI, machine learning or advanced data.
